scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.test:worldclaw: npm run test:worldclaw:unit && npm run test:worldclaw:semantic && npm run test:worldclaw:runtime
scripts.worldclaw:compile:check: node scripts/worldclaw/compile-world.mjs --check && node --input-type=module -e "import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'; import { canonicalStringify, compileWorld } from './scripts/worldclaw/worldclaw-compiler.mjs'; const actual = await readFile('data/world/compiled/world_manifest.json', 'utf8'); const expected = canonicalStringify(await compileWorld(process.cwd()), { pretty: true }); if (actual !== expected) { console.error('Checked WorldClaw manifest is stale. Run npm run worldclaw:compile.'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.verify:worldclaw: npm run worldclaw:export:check && npm run worldclaw:compile:check && npm run worldclaw:emit:check && npm run test:worldclaw
scripts.verify: npm run verify:worldclaw && npm run build && npm run test:node && npm test
